'''Stealth One''' was [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] during the [[Battle of Gilatter VIII]]. After [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to warn Skywalker about the [[Confederation]]'s [[Mine/Legends|mines]], Skywalker used this call sign to alert the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] forces.
